en.headline: Geometry, mechanics, and the shapes we make.
en.intro: I develop computational approaches to understand, represent, and correct three-dimensional shape deformation, connecting geometry and mechanics with physical manufacturing.
en.research_intro: My research connects geometric representations with the physical behavior of manufactured structures.
en.paper_summary: A structural-modal approach to representing and compensating warpage in additive manufacturing.
en.paper: Structure-Aligned Geometric Compensation for Additive Manufacturing Warpage via Vibrational Modal Analysis
en.projects_intro: AI agents, spatial interaction, 3D learning, and computing at scale.
themes: Investigating how structural response influences geometric pre-compensation, and how nominal CAD, manufactured shapes, and measured 3D geometry can be brought into correspondence.
Studying compact structural representations for nonlinear deformation, large rotations, and finite deformation.
Exploring inverse deformation maps and robust geometric modeling operations.

zh-Hans.headline: 从几何与力学，走向真实制造。
zh-Hans.intro: 我研究如何用计算方法理解、表示和补偿三维形变，将几何、力学与实际制造联系起来。
zh-Hans.research_intro: 我的研究关注几何表示与制造结构物理行为之间的联系。
zh-Hans.paper_summary: 通过结构模态表示增材制造中的翘曲，并研究相应的几何补偿。
zh-Hans.paper: Structure-Aligned Geometric Compensation for Additive Manufacturing Warpage via Vibrational Modal Analysis
zh-Hans.projects: 从想法到可运行的代码。
zh-Hans.projects_intro: AI 智能体、空间交互、三维学习与大规模计算。
themes: 研究结构响应如何影响几何预补偿，以及如何建立名义 CAD、制造形状与三维测量数据之间的对应关系。
非线性模态几何与力学
研究适用于非线性形变、大转动与有限变形的紧凑结构表示。
几何逆映射与实体建模
探索逆形变映射与稳健的几何建模运算。
